designationHistory.name: Sacramento Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Sacramento Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7562 on February 27, 1937, and it was renamed Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record) and Pass B (order text on the American Presidency Project; National Archives table) agree. Renamed Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1937 (2 FR 537)
